# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.12

Review-only fix on top of the restored 0.6.5-style Scheduler UI.

## Fixed

- Viewing a task through the card, Edit, or History now acknowledges the current delivery.
- The blue new-delivery dot and Automation tasks unread counter update immediately after the task detail is opened.
- This does not change popup delivery deduplication; a delivery toast is still emitted at most once per delivery.
- The native DSH Rules / Delivery records detail bridge from 0.6.11 is unchanged.

No npm publish requested.
